messages:
jamie: CI red on master for //runtime/serve:stream_checksum_test on macos pool. failing intermittently across builds, log: https://ci.internal/4823 :eyes:
matt: on it — kicking a rerun now
ci-bot: Rerun started for job 4823 (master) — build 4823.1
matt: rerun came back green :shrug: — still flaky
jamie: pasted failing snippet:
```
[ RUN      ] StreamChecksumTest.RandomChunkOrder
runtime/serve/stream_checksum_test.cc:87: Failure
  Expected: checksum == expected
  Which is: 0x1f2a vs 0x1f3b
Stack: /usr/local/...
```
chen: checksum divergence smells like nondet chunk ordering or RNG seed drift
sara: can someone try `bazel test //runtime/serve:stream_checksum_test --runs_per_test=50 --test_arg=--seed=123`? prop tests helpful here
matt: running locally with `TEST_RNG_SEED=1` — reproduces on attempt 8. attaching trace: https://paste.internal/trace/abc
alyssa: if seed-sensitive we should add a deterministic-seed CI job rather than just rerunning
jamie: list of suspicious commits: a11b2..f3c4d changed prefetch order, d5e6f touched checksum calc. Chen, can you bisect a11b2..d5e6f?
chen: will bisect tomorrow. also want to try ASAN/TSAN and run under `--runs_per_test=200` to get repro rate. quick hack: adding a 50us sleep in producer drops repro rate — points to timing/race
matt: could also be integer overflow in rolling checksum with different chunk boundaries after prefetch tweak
sara: I'll add ephemeral CI matrix entry: `matrix.seed=[1,42,123]` and `runs_per_test=20` for the flaky test; helps catch fast regressions
jamie: good. for immediate triage: mark test as flaky, skip on macos pool for now, and queue bisect + tsan. thanks all :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Labelled issue: `ci:red`, added tag `flake:stream-checksum`, created rerun job 4823.2
